title: LiU International Scholarship
program_type: University-administered partial tuition-fee scholarship for fee-paying master's students
duration: The specific year and master's programme stated in the Notification of Selection Results, normally covering a 30-credit workload per semester
description: The LiU International Scholarship is a limited number of tuition-fee reductions awarded by Linköping University to fee-paying international master's students with significant academic potential; the tuition fee of an awardee is normally reduced by 50%. Applicants must have applied in the first admission round, ranked a LiU master's programme first, been admitted to that first choice in the first Notification of Selection Results, and met a minimum academic standard of GPA 3.5 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent. title: Umeå University Scholarship for International Students
program_type: University-administered tuition-fee waiver for fee-paying bachelor's and master's students
duration: Full or partial waiver of the tuition fee for the autumn semester programme
description: The Umeå University Scholarship for International Students is awarded each autumn semester alongside the autumn admission to academically talented applicants who are required to pay tuition fees. title: Melbourne Research Scholarship (MRS)

title: ANU University Research Scholarship
program_type: Academic merit - centrally managed scholarship round
duration: Payments made for 3.5 years (PhD candidates) or 1.5 years (MPhil candidates)
